dedupe_keys.name: sand motor gridded bathymetric and topographic survey

description: TU Delft provides Sand Motor bathymetric and topographic observations gridded at 20 metres. The custom time field spans 3 August 2011 to 7 September 2016. Native relationships identify source survey releases used to create the gridded representation. Coverage: 2011-08-03T00:00Z/2016-09-07T00:00Z. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: A 20-metre grid is the stated representation spacing and does not establish survey accuracy. The gridded output is distinct from actual surveyed paths and cross-shore transect representations. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
